summary: A logical coordination-lane name was mapped to an existing physical Bus lane before the dedicated lane provisioning state was checked.
observed_behavior: Sol inferred that the requested logical lane heart-n-sol likely mapped to bus/vera-sol-v1 because no literal heart-n-sol branch was initially visible.
error_characterization: A material naming/topology ambiguity was resolved by inference before the authoritative Bus provisioning state was established. Subsequent fresh-checking showed a dedicated heart-n-sol lane was being provisioned.

summary: A repository component name was initially mistaken for proof that generated SQL used an explicit confirmation gate.
observed_behavior: Sol initially inferred that SQLChat's ActionConfirmModal represented the generated-SQL execution confirmation boundary.
error_characterization: Component existence was conflated with actual execution-path use. Source-level tracing showed generated SQL is inspectable/editable and separately run, while non-SELECT statements receive a warning rather than the assumed confirmation-modal gate.

summary: An ambiguous tool semantic was noticed before being treated as authoritative currentness evidence.
observed_behavior: Sol initially used the repository commit-search surface to identify apparent live heads, then recognized that the operation did not explicitly guarantee default-branch-head semantics and rechecked repository metadata plus exact git refs before binding the currentness snapshot.
